## Verification

List the commands, tests, and manual checks you ran.

## User-facing evidence

Add screenshots or recordings for visible changes, or write "Not applicable."

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and does not include unrelated generated files.
- [ ] Tests cover new behavior or explain why no test is needed.
- [ ] Documentation and localization resources are updated where applicable.
- [ ] No secrets, private user data, signing material, or release artifacts are included.
- [ ] Privacy, security, migration, and compatibility effects are documented.
- [ ] Material AI assistance is disclosed and the output was reviewed.
